leads.summary: #12808 adds a fifth terminal whose idle launch never forwards --idle, while this PR's four-branch test still passes
leads.consequence: The branches merge without conflicts, and the WezTerm invocation remains `-- omarchy-screensaver`, not `-- omarchy-screensaver --idle`. During an idle launch whose WezTerm window never obtains focus, that instance takes the manual eight-poll exit path, closes its tracked window and can cancel the pending lock at Service.qml:130-140. The four-line assertion does not see the fifth branch. Integrate by passing the same screensaver_cmd array on the WezTerm branch and extending the fixture to enumerate every terminal branch.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (count-check blind spot); published as optional note 2

leads.summary: #10483's configurable launch command conflicts with the --idle launch and drops the flag in its default
leads.consequence: The heads are diverged; merge-file has a conflict on the idle launcher call. If the configurable command version is chosen with its shipped default `omarchy-launch-screensaver`, an ordinary idle cycle no longer passes --idle, and a never-focused screensaver exits after eight polls, closing the tracked window and cancelling the lock. Resolve the conflict by keeping --idle on the built-in default while preserving the alternate command contract, and test both configurations.
leads.triage: already in Opus final and in second review; covered by 'unchanged since then' in details

leads.summary: Additional open #13637 and #7102 compete for the same focus latch without this PR's manual-only bound
leads.consequence: Neither competing head is stacked on this head. A real merge of #13637 and this head produces two conflict regions, the latch and polling loop. Choosing #13637's `was_focused` polling condition in the resolution without preserving `screensaver_unfocused_limit` regresses the bound for a manually launched window that never takes focus: it stays running until input rather than exiting after eight polls. The analogous #7102 focus latch also lacks this bound. These PRs are alternatives requiring an integrated resolution, not an automatically clean combined fix.
leads.triage: already in Opus final; published in overlapping PRs table

leads.summary: The changed test does not check the actual --idle argument-processing call
leads.consequence: The test sources the script without arguments, manually sets screensaver_idle=1 and separately calls screensaver_apply_args --idle. Removing the production call `screensaver_apply_args "$@"` leaves all eight test assertions green (sealed mutant exit 0). In production, every `--idle` then stays at the manual default 0 and a never-focused idle screensaver exits after eight polls; Service.qml treats the closed window as a dismissal and cancels pending lock. Assert that sourcing with --idle sets screensaver_idle without directly invoking the helper, as well as that no-arg sourcing leaves it zero.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (M4); published as optional note 1

limits: Runtime focus behaviour is inferred from the PR's own focus and idle-service code and controlled tests, not observed on a live compositor. The hunt did not trace external Hyprland/Quickshell implementations at shipped versions and makes no claim about the frequency of never-focused windows.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No defects in the new commits; one clash with #7193 not raised before.

Follow-up on the [second review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12258#issuecomment-5860791872) and [reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12258#issuecomment-5861121061), at `77961872`.

- Executable bits: **resolved**.
- Optional `--idle` tests: **mostly resolved**, 2 of 3 mutations caught.
- Overlapping PRs: **still present**, more than listed.
- First review's points: **still resolved**.

### #7193's native screensaver exits on `--idle`

#7193 merges with this PR without a conflict. Its launcher execs the native binary with `"$@"` before the `--idle` handling, and the binary exits 2 on unknown arguments. **Impact:** with it installed, idle cycles show no screensaver; the lock still fires. Not run.

**Suggested change:** strip `--idle` before the native exec, or have the binary accept it.

<details><summary>Details: #7193 source</summary>

- #7193 `bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver`: `if [[ -x $native_screensaver ]]; then exec "$native_screensaver" "$@"; fi`, with `native_screensaver=/usr/lib/omarchy-screensaver/omarchy-screensaver`.
- [tobi/omarchy-launch-screensaver v1.0.0](https://github.com/tobi/omarchy-launch-screensaver/tree/v1.0.0), the version #7193 names: `src/options.rs` ends its argument match with `_ => bail!("unknown arg {raw}")`, and `src/main.rs` prints the error and returns `ExitCode::from(2)`.
- This PR's `Service.qml` launches `omarchy-launch-screensaver --idle`, so the native binary would receive `--idle`.
</details>
<details><summary>Details: overlapping open PRs</summary>

The four PRs named in the second review (#12808, #13475, #12730, #10483) have not changed since then and still overlap as described. Other open PRs on the same lines:

| PR | Overlap |
|---|---|
| #13637, #7102 | Replace the same watchdog condition with a "stay up until first focus" latch, with no bound for a never-focused launch and no idle exception. Conflict in `bin/omarchy-screensaver`. #13637 was opened after the second review; #7102 already existed then. |
| #13647 | Rewrites the same watchdog condition. Conflict in `bin/omarchy-screensaver`. |
| #7307, #7766, #10751 | #7307 and #7766 rewrite all four terminal exec lines, #10751 the kitty line, with plain `-e omarchy-screensaver`. Conflict in the launcher. The new four-branch check fails a resolution that keeps their lines. |
| #9493 | Moves the idle launch out of `Service.qml` with a fallback command without `--idle`. Conflict in `Service.qml`. |
| #11146, #11191, #6813, #8556 | Add the same `test/shell.d/screensaver-test.sh` path, like #12730. |

Conflicts are from merge checks of each PR head against `77961872`.
</details>
<details><summary>Details: verified</summary>

- Both scripts are mode `100755` again. Merged into current `quattro`, `screensaver-test.sh` and `quattro`'s `screensaver-workspace-test.sh` both pass. With the launcher set back to `0644`, the workspace test fails with `Permission denied` (exit 126).
- Mutations now caught: the argument loop no longer setting `screensaver_idle`, and any terminal branch reverted to `-e omarchy-screensaver`.
- Stubbed runs of the executed watchdog: a manual launch that never gets focus exits after 8 polls; an `--idle` launch keeps polling.
- Nothing else in the head tree or `quattro` sources `bin/omarchy-screensaver`, and the test runner passes the test no arguments, so the `screensaver_apply_args "$@"` call above the source guard does nothing there.
</details>
<details><summary>Optional test notes</summary>

**1. The top-level `screensaver_apply_args "$@"` call is untested.** Deleting it still passes the test, and that mutant makes an idle launch give up after 8 unfocused polls (stubbed run). Sourcing the script with `--idle` and asserting `screensaver_idle == 1` catches it.

Run from a checkout of the PR head `77961872`. Removing the top-level `screensaver_apply_args "$@"` call, so that `omarchy-screensaver --idle` never takes the idle path, still passes the test:

```bash
sed -i '/^screensaver_apply_args "\$@"$/d' bin/omarchy-screensaver
bash test/shell.d/screensaver-test.sh
```

```text
ok - screensaver does not treat the first unfocused poll as dismissal
ok - screensaver stays up before it has been focused
ok - screensaver stays up once it is focused
ok - screensaver dismisses after losing focus
ok - manual screensaver gives up when it never receives focus
ok - idle screensaver keeps waiting for focus
ok - screensaver records --idle from its arguments
ok - every terminal launcher forwards the screensaver command
[exit 0]
```

Appending this to `test/shell.d/screensaver-test.sh` sources the script with `--idle` as its argument, the way the terminal runs it:

```bash
# Source the script the way the terminal runs it, with --idle as its argument,
# so the top-level call to screensaver_apply_args is covered too.
screensaver_idle=0
source "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-screensaver" --idle
((screensaver_idle == 1)) || fail "omarchy-screensaver --idle takes the idle path"
pass "omarchy-screensaver --idle takes the idle path"
```

With the call removed, the extended test fails:

```text
ok - screensaver does not treat the first unfocused poll as dismissal
ok - screensaver stays up before it has been focused
ok - screensaver stays up once it is focused
ok - screensaver dismisses after losing focus
ok - manual screensaver gives up when it never receives focus
ok - idle screensaver keeps waiting for focus
ok - screensaver records --idle from its arguments
ok - every terminal launcher forwards the screensaver command
not ok - omarchy-screensaver --idle takes the idle path
[exit 1]
```

On the unmodified head, the extended test passes:

```text
ok - screensaver does not treat the first unfocused poll as dismissal
ok - screensaver stays up before it has been focused
ok - screensaver stays up once it is focused
ok - screensaver dismisses after losing focus
ok - manual screensaver gives up when it never receives focus
ok - idle screensaver keeps waiting for focus
ok - screensaver records --idle from its arguments
ok - every terminal launcher forwards the screensaver command
ok - omarchy-screensaver --idle takes the idle path
[exit 0]
```

`[exit N]` lines are the command's exit status, added by the harness.

**2. The exact count of 4 does not see a fifth terminal branch that does not use `-e`.** After merging #12808 (keeping this PR's watchdog), the test passes while the WezTerm branch runs a bare `-- omarchy-screensaver`. Failing on any bare `-e omarchy-screensaver` or `-- omarchy-screensaver` catches it.

From a checkout of the PR head `77961872`, merge #12808 at its current head `c77e26d7`:

```bash
git fetch origin c77e26d7e055b5141be88248922a1a77cc171351
git merge --no-ff --no-edit c77e26d7e055b5141be88248922a1a77cc171351
```

```text
Auto-merging bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver

CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in bin/omarchy-screensaver
Recorded preimage for 'bin/omarchy-screensaver'

```

Keep this PR's side of the watchdog conflict (output of these three commands omitted):

```bash
git checkout --ours bin/omarchy-screensaver
git add bin/omarchy-screensaver
git commit --no-edit
```

The launcher merged without a conflict and the test passes, but the WezTerm branch still runs a bare `omarchy-screensaver`:

```bash
bash test/shell.d/screensaver-test.sh
grep -nE -- '(-e|--) omarchy-screensaver( |$)' bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver
```

```text
ok - screensaver does not treat the first unfocused poll as dismissal
ok - screensaver stays up before it has been focused
ok - screensaver stays up once it is focused
ok - screensaver dismisses after losing focus
ok - manual screensaver gives up when it never receives focus
ok - idle screensaver keeps waiting for focus

[exit 0]
80:    hypr_exec wezterm-gui --config-file "$OMARCHY_PATH/default/wezterm/screensaver.lua" start --always-new-process --class org.omarchy.screensaver -- omarchy-screensaver
[exit 0]
```

A check that fails on any bare `-e omarchy-screensaver` or `-- omarchy-screensaver` would catch this:

```bash
if grep -nE -- '(-e|--) omarchy-screensaver( |$)' "$ROOT/bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver"; then
  fail "every terminal launcher forwards the screensaver command"
fi
```

The same grep matches nothing on the unmerged PR head, so the check passes there.

`[exit N]` lines are exit statuses, added by the harness.

**3. The launcher's `--idle` match is still untested** (the text checks cover the array and the exec lines). Making it never match passes the test. After a rebase onto `quattro`, an `--idle` case in `screensaver-workspace-test.sh` asserting the exec command contains `-e omarchy-screensaver --idle` would catch it.

Run from a checkout of the PR head `77961872`. Making the launcher never match `--idle`, so every launch gets the plain `omarchy-screensaver` command, still passes the test:

grep -n 'never-idle' bin/omarchy-launch-screensaver
